parts.text: The new service runs on a single server, and it is updated and restarted during working hours while drones are flying, alongside occasional crashes that the companies accept for a few minutes of interruption. Management or analytical reports, exports, dashboards beyond day-to-day operations, weather information, billing or pricing, and signing up new companies through the service are explicitly not wanted. Furthermore, the service must not provide accounts and passwords inside it, several languages, e-mail, text message, or phone alerts to staff, route planning, drone picking, remote flying, backups, high availability, or spreading the service over several servers.
